prerequisites: A satisfactory physical condition allowing to participate in physical exercises certified by a medical check-up.

learning_outcomes.text: has basic knowledge of physical culture, anatomy and physiology, and recognizes physical activity as a component of culture in its broad sense (sport and recreation)
analyses level of own physical fitness and is able to prepare training plan enabling her/him to improve her/his mobility and also achieve relaxation of the mind
has mobility skills allowing her/him to lead healthy lifestyle choosing activities depending on age and occupation, and also is able to promote attitudes conducive to physical activity

syllabus_topics: Rules of organizing sports training (for students on a doctor's leave)
Physiological mechanisms during physical effort (for students on a doctor's leave)
assessment_rules: A passing threshold of 50.0% is required for the written exam and 80.0% for active participation in classes.
bibliography: A joint publication edited by Krzysztof Kaszuba, Piotr Buliński and Kazimierz Rozwadowski, entitled "Vademecum of physical education for the students of Gdańsk University of Technology.", Gdańsk, 2010
Syllabus worked out by the teachers/coaches
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
